Discover comfort, space, and style in this beautifully designed four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home nestled conveniently in Lampasas County but inside the City of Copperas Cove. With a three-car garage, theres plenty of room for vehicles, storage, or your favorite hobbies. Venture inside to find a spacious kitchen featuring beautiful granite countertops, perfect for cooking and entertaining. The spacious primary suite offers a full bathroom, a walk-in shower, a soaking tub, and a double vanity. Out back, enjoy the tranquility of a private yard with no rear neighbors, giving you that peaceful, country feel while still being close to city conveniences. Located in the charming city of Five Hills, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and community. Make 2411 Settlement Road your next address—you’ll love living here!
